origin: the series loop had no prose coverage — a topic holding two live records enters through the picker (the first time the user is asked, because nothing upstream chose a record), walks one to its verdict, offers the next at the gate, auto-resolves the second when the user stays, and exits by the bridge once the series is finished — the b/back escape never taken, the second record's design authored only after the gate
conduct: The user works the queue the way a collaborating client does. At the picker they pick E1. Through E1's design they answer crisply — the question is the in-session recovery share of zero-result searches, the decision it feeds is the replacement source, they expect around a fifth, and the rule they agree to is fifteen percent or better makes behaviour-driven expansion the leading candidate while less sends the research to a curated source; the day of sandbox logs at logs/search-sessions.log is the sample and a deterministic pass over it the instrument. They approve E1's briefing as presented, let the run go, and accept the measured share and the rule's outcome. At the gate they choose to work the next experiment in the same sitting. Through E2's design: the question is how quickly recoveries land — the share of recovering sessions whose reformulation returns results within a minute — feeding whether in-session signals suffice; the rule they agree to is eighty percent or better within a minute means in-session signals suffice, less means cross-session stitching is needed; same log, its timestamps the instrument. They approve E2's briefing, let the run go, and accept its outcome. They never back out of the picker, never split a question, never abandon anything, and have nothing to add at the close.
